accounted_energy_definition: KE+IE+rotation+spring+contact+hourglass-external_work. Plastic work is already within IE and is not added twice; elastic/friction/damping contact terms are subcomponents of contact energy.

last_corner_velocity_diagnostics.support: 76065 physical solid corner nodes only, excludes midsides and wall display
last_corner_velocity_diagnostics.note: Local outward motion is distinct from whole-assembly COM rebound.

initial_momentum_note: Actual global history P/M differs slightly from nominal INIVEL speed; no nodal t0 velocity was stored in the original20us ANIM, and the cause of this difference is not independently isolated. Rebound determination uses the actual P/M sign history.
interpretation: Normal COM velocity is derived from actual global momentum/mass, with original wall normal. Saved stress extrema are snapshot maxima, not guaranteed continuous-time peaks. An apparent local maximum or COM sign reversal alone does not establish all full-product response requirements.
AI_scope: The nine-condition learning data remain nominal2..20us only. This is a single center FEM diagnostic, not an AI extrapolation validation.
